historical_reviews.deepseek: Maintains the human injection boundary but assumes Linux dmesg on a Windows boot, truncates logs, omits the required Cscript error output and disables SSH trust.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly centers the specified UC link-layer/PHY-control signature and FAE-controlled target/recovery.
historical_reviews.adjacent_cases: Data-lane failover tests degraded-link continuity; Three-Strike expects a catastrophic crash. Neither is equivalent to this link-layer error check.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Critical injection requires exact package/target, protected evidence, no autonomous recovery or retry, and engineer verdict.

original_test_intent: Inject a UPI link-layer fault into each approved socket/port and prove the Intel diagnostic reports the specified UC link-layer or PHY-control error, with corroborating platform logs and physical indication and successful recovery.
original_method: A qualified FAE/operator enables the listed EDKII settings on an isolated Windows SUT, maps ITP topology to the physical UPI link, performs one approved `injectUpiLLError`, captures the complete `error.check_upi_errors()` output, resumes/recoveries the system, gathers authoritative Windows RAS, BMC and UEFI evidence plus the front-panel state, and restores settings.
manual_activity: The FAE/operator must map the target, enable/restore BIOS settings, drive the Intel injector and diagnostic, watch the front panel and execute recovery. Agent activity is limited to approved evidence capture.
required_inputs: Supported ITP/CScripts build/hash and approved injectUpiLLError/error.check_upi_errors semantics
Exact UC LL/PHY signature plus deterministic Windows/BMC/UEFI and indicator oracle
One-shot timeout, abort, recovery and BIOS restoration procedure
safety_requirements: Dedicated idle SUT, stable power, independent console and FAE approval
Preserve baseline evidence instead of clearing it
Verify physical target mapping before the single bounded injection
Abort on wrong link, uncontrolled loss, crash, thermal/power anomaly or no console
No automatic rerun, reset or power cycle; restore only under the vendor plan
agent_execution_scope: Check supplied identities/package hashes/topology and capture non-mutating baseline/post-state evidence
Do not alter BIOS, choose a port, run ITP/Cscripts, inject, recover the SUT or decide the hardware verdict
engineer_actions: Approve package, topology and command semantics
Define the exact mandatory Cscript and cross-plane signatures
Reconcile Windows with dmesg and replace `may`/`if there is one` with deterministic conditions
Approve recovery, restoration and final result

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SSH grep is not the injector or required diagnostic, assumes Linux after a Windows boot, loses context, cannot observe the lamp and weakens host verification.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the exact FAE-operated ITP/Cscripts flow; any agent command must be an approved read-only export from Windows/BMC after the event.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: `ei.injectUpiLLError(socket,port)`, `error.check_upi_errors()`, Socket 0~N and time estimates remain literal; target and semantics are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record topology binding and package hash, perform one bounded injection, retain the full diagnostic transcript, synchronize Windows/BMC/UEFI/indicator evidence, verify link/system recovery and diff BIOS settings.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic evidence and safety controls while preserving the exact link-layer stimulus and signature.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A post-event grep alone cannot prove the intended link was injected or that the required Intel diagnostic string appeared.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An uncorrectable link-layer fault may disable inter-socket connectivity or crash the platform and can leave debug controls enabled.

project_override_considerations: User/FAE package and approval make the workflow conditionally executable, but do not authorize autonomous BIOS changes, injection or recovery. Missing readiness is BLOCKED, never DUT FAIL.
expected_evidence: FAE approval and complete SUT/CPU/firmware/OS/BMC identity
Package hash, topology/port map, target rationale and injection transcript
Full `error.check_upi_errors()` output containing the approved signature
Authoritative Windows RAS, BMC SEL and recovered UEFI SEL with timestamps
Front-panel evidence, link/system recovery, BIOS restoration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Windows is specified but dmesg is the OS criterion; BMC/UEFI use non-deterministic `may`; and front-panel lighting is conditioned only by `if there is one`, without platform applicability or exact state.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The stimulus and one diagnostic signature are explicit, so the case can proceed after exact package, target, deterministic cross-plane oracle, recovery and operator approval are supplied.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 8 Wistron-System RAS-00728-V003: approve SUT/UPI socket-port topology, Intel ITP/CScripts version/hash and exact `injectUpiLLError`/`error.check_upi_errors` semantics; define one-shot timeout, abort/recovery and BIOS restoration; reconcile Windows with dmesg; and make the Cscript, BMC/UEFI and front-panel expectations deterministic, including the exact accepted UC LL versus PHY Control signature.

review_improvement: The review preserves the source's distinctive Intel diagnostic oracle and prevents generic UPI log evidence from being counted as link-layer injection coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: The required string from `error.check_upi_errors()` is the only source-specific oracle separating this case from neighboring UPI injections, so its full output and mapping to the injected port are mandatory. A log from some UPI error cannot prove link-layer targeting. The Windows/dmesg mismatch and optional BMC/UEFI wording leave the other planes unsuitable for verdicts until corrected. Because wrong-port UC injection can remove a live inter-socket path, topology selection and recovery must remain FAE-controlled. The case is conditionally executable rather than intrinsically blocked.
